entities.name: Loot Niptil
entities.description: An amnesia-afflicted wizard framed for murder in Automatown.

entities.name: Justiciar of Automatown
entities.description: An automaton built by Haspian Chastoril that enforces trial by combat.

entities.name: Haspian Chastoril
entities.description: The forger who built the Justiciar and murdered the inventor Sopti Borth.

entities.name: Sopti Borth
entities.description: An inventor whose murder Loot is framed for.

entities.name: Kyyrao Grrenmw
entities.description: A cat warrior who helps Loot defeat the Justiciar.

entities.name: Gormank
entities.description: An ogre who seeks to have Eorra resurrected so he can kill her personally and restore his honor.

entities.name: Eorra
entities.description: An elvish woman, the only person to best Gormank in combat, resurrected severely weakened.

entities.name: Boxx
entities.description: A wizard who uses a box as a stand-in for his body and resurrects Eorra.

entities.name: Dolores
entities.description: The Lady of Sorrow of Coraleon who forbids magic during the Festival of Sorrow yet lets the ritual proceed to crush Gormank.

entities.name: Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar
entities.description: A female wizard and great cook who becomes chef to the Lord of the Pit Vincent and writes The Underworld Cookbook.

entities.name: Vincent
entities.description: A Lord of the Pit summoned by Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar who proposes marriage to her.

entities.name: Peter Langwynd
entities.description: A sorcerer-naturalist who hides as a hermit in the Fens of Foulmere.

entities.name: Vram
entities.description: A planeswalker who wants to use a Big Bog Frog in battles and is revealed as a Dobehma.

entities.name: Mao
entities.description: Peter's cat, revealed as a Dobehma girl.

entities.name: Rafthrasa
entities.description: A planeswalker and former god-emperor of Kartya who wants to live as a mortal farmer.

entities.name: Torya Longshanks
entities.description: A farmer-soldier who ends King Rogan's curse.

entities.name: Rogan
entities.description: King of Angremur, cursed to become a monster each night.

entities.name: Leaf
entities.description: An elder of Savaea who is killed trying to teach Kruuna about the cycle of life and death.

entities.name: Kruuna
entities.description: The goblin chieftess who uses an Ivory Cup to stay immortal.

entities.name: Busjaw
entities.description: A goblin messenger sent to the elves.

entities.name: Helana
entities.description: A sun-priest's adopted daughter who journeys into Hell to rescue her father and ends half-dark.

entities.name: Koborah
entities.description: A sun priest summoned away by a planeswalker.

entities.name: Illith
entities.description: A demon who accompanies Helana into Hell.

entities.name: Gohrah
entities.description: Goddess of the dark half of the Moon who covertly guided Helana.

entities.name: Kebwin
entities.description: A dwarven boy who fights in dream wars and dies.

entities.name: Somilar
entities.description: An orcish girl who fights in dream wars and ends catatonic.

entities.name: Teeka
entities.description: A talented artificer who builds a guardian dragon to protect her creations.

entities.name: Xavis
entities.description: A wizard who has fought another wizard for 10 million years and learns he was created by his opponent.

entities.name: Hamu
entities.description: A Hurloon minotaur who takes in the pregnant human Ikenet.

entities.name: Ikenet
entities.description: An acrobat who becomes the first Horn Dancer.

entities.name: Makura
entities.description: The Great Mother of the Hurloon minotaurs who chooses Hamu as her Consort.

entities.name: Herhoona
entities.description: An arrogant minotaur executed for charging Makura.

entities.name: Shen
entities.description: A cat warrior who is wrongly credited with killing a mage.

entities.name: Joerrin
entities.description: A human woman who lives with Shen's tribe and uses illusory cat warriors in a duel.

entities.name: Granite Gargoyle
entities.description: A gargoyle left alone in Binyen who decides to guard a Shivan Dragon.

entities.name: Spirokai
entities.description: An Akron Legionnaire who feels no pain and survives being buried alive.

entities.name: Ophelia
entities.description: Methos's sister who frees the Abuser and leaves Vacar Slab alone.

entities.name: The Abuser
entities.description: A man the Kenlefians bring to Vacar Slab to be executed.

entities.name: Distant Planes
entities.description: A HarperPrism Magic anthology first published in June 1996 and edited by Kathy Ice.

events.summary: Loot is framed for Sopti Borth's murder, fights the Justiciar with Kyyrao and the marshal, and exposes Haspian as the killer.
events.quote: He learns that the killer is Haspian Chastoril , the forger who built the Justiciar.

events.summary: Boxx resurrects Eorra, who is too weakened for Gormank to reclaim his honor; Dolores reveals she allowed it to crush him.
events.quote: as she had seen into Gormank's soul and knew that the result would crush him.

events.summary: Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar becomes Vincent's chef to avoid being eaten, then is freed but hunted by creatures her cookbook calls delicious.
events.quote: After her time is up, Vincent proposes to marry her, but she turns him down, and he releases her to the overworld as promised.

events.summary: Vram blows up the swamp and is expelled from the plane; the bog becomes a black peat bog of undead.
events.quote: Vram blows up the swamp and is sent hurtling through the multiverse

events.summary: Rafthrasa finally gets the islanders to leave him alone by solving their famine and beetle infestation.
events.quote: he eventually gets them to leave him alone by helping them get rid of the famine and beetle infestation plaguing the island.

events.summary: Torya ends King Rogan's nightly monster curse by scraping her hand on the beast and stays to help him rule.
events.quote: She stays to help the king become a good ruler, and he welcomes her.

events.summary: Leaf is clubbed by Kruuna and the elves kill Kruuna with arrows.
events.quote: The elves immediately shoot Kruuna full of arrows, killing her on the spot.

events.summary: Helana rescues her father from Hell, but the Archduke dies and she becomes half-dark and gives up her priesthood.
events.quote: She has to give up her priesthood and walk away from her father and parish

events.summary: Dream war wounds leave Somilar catatonic and Kebwin dead.
events.quote: but by then Somilar is catatonic, and Kebwin is dead.

events.summary: Teeka builds a guardian dragon, which returns with a note asking to lease it.
events.quote: How much to lease this dragon?

events.summary: Xavis learns his opponent created him to fight the creator's true enemy.
Makura chooses Hamu as Consort; Herhoona charges Makura and is executed.
events.quote: but is tackled down by other males and executed by one of the Grandmothers

events.summary: Shen is credited with killing an enemy mage, earning the name Mage-Slayer.
The Granite Gargoyle decides to guard a temperamental Shivan Dragon despite her attacks.
events.quote: the gargoyle decides that she needs guarding

events.summary: Ophelia frees the Abuser; Spirokai buries him, a zombified Teeth strikes Spirokai, and Ophelia leaves alone.
events.quote: Ophelia, now the sole apparent survivor, but carrying both a weapon and water, leaves Vacar Slab alone.
